- Load (drawn as part of the vehicle): two brown-and-white calves behind wooden side rails

- Finish: mud-caked lower panels

Secure load with straps or rails, realistic proportions; higher tier stronger and better equipped.  strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Soft even daylight, full object with generous margins all sides, true transparent background. No ground, cast shadow, text, logos, watermark. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels across.
